new_artifact_candidates.description: A chest given by Regan, strongly encouraged to hold the party's magic weapons and items.
properties: Container for magic weapons and items
new_artifact_candidates.evidence: Regan presented the party with a Leomund's secret chest and encouraged them to place all their magic weapons and items inside it.

new_artifact_candidates.description: A keycard given by Regan, used for finding the Overseer's Manor.
new_artifact_candidates.evidence: Regan gave each of you a blood-red gemstone keycard and mentioned that you could find him at the Overseer's Manor further down the trail.

new_artifact_candidates.description: Items that lost their service/function when the yurt power failed.
new_artifact_candidates.evidence: The service on the speaking stones ceased when the yurt's power went out.

new_artifact_candidates.description: Consumable item that, when consumed, triggers a magical effect (Bless spell) and inflicts necrotic damage.
new_artifact_candidates.evidence: Nayak slurps up a ghoul tongue like it's spaghetti... and you have the Bane spell cast on you.

new_artifact_candidates.description: Found clutched by one of the corpses.
new_artifact_candidates.evidence: One body clutches a bloodstained longbow.
Another holds a set of rusty short swords.

new_artifact_candidates.description: Found cradled by the third corpse.
new_artifact_candidates.evidence: The third bears no weapon, but cradles a crumpled envelope close to their chest.

new_artifact_candidates.description: Nyack attempts to take the longbow from a zombie.
new_artifact_candidates.evidence: Nyack's gonna try to approach one of the zombies and take the longbow.

new_artifact_candidates.description: Nyack demands the return of his pickled tongues.
new_artifact_candidates.evidence: Give me back my pickled tongues.

new_artifact_candidates.description: A zombie was observed clutching an envelope.
new_artifact_candidates.evidence: The zombie was seen clutching an envelope during the encounter.

new_artifact_candidates.description: The journal is described as powerful and used for manifesting.
new_artifact_candidates.evidence: The character states, 'I'm going to take out my journal because ever since I cut the cord... my journal is so powerful.'

new_artifact_candidates.description: Obsidian is described with unusual physical features: cucumbers on his eyes and a seaweed wrap on his horn.
properties: has a seaweed wrap on his horn
new_artifact_candidates.evidence: The character refers to 'Obsidian snoring blissfully on your bed' and describes him as having 'cucumbers on his eyes and a seaweed wrap on his horn.'

new_artifact_candidates.description: A familiar, an imp, was summoned via a spell/pact.
new_artifact_candidates.evidence: The character states, 'And From the Page steps up a little imp who's now my Pact of the Chain familiar.'

new_artifact_candidates.description: A trinket found half-buried in the soil during an encounter.
new_artifact_candidates.lore_significance: A discovered item from a random encounter.
new_artifact_candidates.evidence: The speaker mentions: "there is something half buried there uh and you have found another trinket... niac stick your hand in there and get it"

new_artifact_candidates.description: Observed looking around and suggesting disguise.
new_artifact_candidates.evidence: The party observes Keychain looking around as they walk past a guard post.

new_artifact_candidates.description: A wooden block used to facilitate movement, causing the holder to 'bounce along' while walking.
new_artifact_candidates.lore_significance: Used as a magical focus or mechanism to aid in locomotion.
new_artifact_candidates.evidence: The party discussed putting the 'little wooden block' on Bluetooth's head, and it caused him to 'bounce along, balancing it perfectly' while walking.

new_artifact_candidates.description: A robot keychain that mixes up experimental elixirs.
new_artifact_candidates.lore_significance: A mundane item that was present in the yurt.
new_artifact_candidates.evidence: The party found their 'faithful robot keychain' in the yurt.

new_artifact_candidates.description: A sword found among the human corpses.
new_artifact_candidates.lore_significance: A mundane weapon found during the investigation of the corpses.
new_artifact_candidates.evidence: The party found a sword among the corpses.

new_artifact_candidates.description: A magical mark placed on a target, marking them as quarry.
new_artifact_candidates.lore_significance: Used by the character to mark a target as quarry during combat.
new_artifact_candidates.evidence: I'm going to cast a bonus action hunter's mark on him and I'm gonna mark him as my quarry.
